Circle Time Activity – Rolling the Clips 🧷🧵

Children pull the thread through the roll, taking out the clipped pieces one by one and collecting all the clips. This activity helps develop hand-eye coordination, concentration, fine-motor skills, and patience. 💜

👑🔍 Word Search Crown – Circle Time Activity! 🔍👑

Learning becomes more fun when we learn together! 💜✨

Our little learners were paired up, with each child wearing a Word Search Crown filled with different words. One child carefully observed their partner’s crown, read out the words, and the other child wrote them down in their workbook. 📝📖

A fun and engaging activity that encourages word recognition, reading skills, concentration, listening, and teamwork! 🌟👫
